description: The names set up to buy, each with its entry window: the candidates a disciplined agent considers, and the ones that would be a chase. Today's ranked buy-list sample per book across two lanes (risk-adjusted and swing): buy candidates among US stocks and ETFs (the crypto book lists coins), as the top pick per lane and the top 3 READY candidates overall, each with its buy band (high or medium), entry window (READY or SETTING UP) and ladder permission, plus the regime mode showing whether the list is actionable at all and the full READY count. Free sample: one pick per lane and 3 candidates, buy score as a band, one market day delayed.
name: get_buy_list
